docs.text: BMO: The Line-Following Arduino Robot # In fall 2025, I recreated the loveable gaming handheld character, BMO, from Adventure Time! This project occurred from late August to late November and was accomplished by a team of five engineers (including myself). As the project lead, my main goal was ensuring the team progressed smoothly, taking in everyones' thoughts and opinions, and communicating with teaching assistants and the professor for instruction and feedback.
